requested_outcome: Implement every approved administration improvement from the supplied plan except original section 2, with truthful booking, reporting, content, quality, magazine and Professor behavior.
natural_destination: The authenticated VII administration routes and their connected data sources in the local release candidate.
authorization_boundary: Local source, tests, fixtures and saved evidence only. No public deployment, production data mutation, external booking, outbound message or analytics publication is authorized in this task.

lesson_bundle.reason: The task is a broad daily-use administration upgrade.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every changed module must expose a clear task, authoritative save/read behavior, permissions, audit context and usable next action.

lesson_bundle.reason: Bookings, report totals, statuses and quality metrics are visible operational facts.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every value must identify its source, formula or status semantics, period, freshness and reconciliation evidence; intent cannot be shown as completion.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request explicitly requires clickable counts, shortcuts, filters and actions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: All visible controls are inventoried and exercised in enabled, disabled, loading, empty, error and persistence states.

lesson_bundle.reason: A code-only change would not prove the administration journeys work.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact local candidate must be opened at the natural admin routes and tested end to end before completion.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user asked for a coherent future-facing admin rather than repetitive boxes and unclear text.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Desktop and 390px admin views must show restrained spacing, hierarchy, readable statuses and no dead or duplicate frames.

lesson_bundle.reason: Original section 2 is explicitly excluded while adjacent reporting work remains included.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: No business-performance graph expansion is introduced; existing verified capabilities outside the listed scope remain unchanged.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A spa click or iframe opening is reported as a completed Titanic booking.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Separate intent, pending, confirmed, rejected and unknown states and require provider acknowledgement before confirmation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Tests and UI evidence show no confirmed booking without a provider reference, and duplicate reconciliation is idempotent.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Professor still gives generic or cache-missing answers and loses recent questions.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Persist recent questions, refresh connected evidence automatically, expose source/freshness/failure, and preserve the active result across reload.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A simple and a business question both return sourced states; recent shortcuts persist and a source failure is explicit.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Report or quality failures are flattened to zero or identical boilerplate.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Model fresh, stale, partial, unsupported, unavailable and failed states separately with action links.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Negative fixtures render distinct statuses, timestamps, counts and recommended actions without false zeroes.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Clickable numbers only filter the current page or lose the user's context.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use canonical query-state links and server-side/full-dataset search, pagination and export.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Count links preserve world, date, search, sort and page intent and reach the complete filtered dataset.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Content and magazine statuses remain ambiguous and redirects/canonicals are not actionable.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Separate publication state from edit state and show public/edit/source/target/sitemap/redirect evidence plus next action.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Existing-live-with-draft, new-draft, scheduled, archived and redirect cases each render distinct truthful labels and links.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The change looks good in source but is not usable on the actual admin screens.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run compiled local browser checks on desktop and 390px, including loading, empty, failure, retry, reload and back.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Natural-destination screenshots and interaction receipts cover every changed admin family.

affected_family: spa booking readiness/status and analytics contract
Biz report ingestion, cache and reconciliation
content approval queue, canonical pages, sitemaps and redirects
quality and stability dashboard and scheduler states
actionable admin counters and context-preserving links
business-performance full dataset search/pagination/export without graph redesign
shared admin typography, spacing, loading, error, empty and permission states

sources.label: VII platform truth and administration invariants
VII accepted administration and booking behavior
User-supplied approved implementation plan excluding section 2

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the first truthful end-to-end slice for Professor and booking/report status models is implemented and tested, before broad visual expansion.
checks: Professor recent/search/cache/failure slice works from API to rendered admin UI
booking and report states do not convert unknown, unsupported or failed sources into success or zero

attack_questions: Can a click, iframe open or GTM event still appear as a confirmed booking without provider proof?
Can a source outage or stale cache still appear as zero, fresh or successful?
Can a count link, search or export omit records outside the current page or lose filters?
Can an existing published page with draft edits still be mislabeled only as draft?
Can a 390px Hebrew admin view hide an action, wrap mixed-direction data incorrectly or show an unapproved fallback font?
Did any excluded section 2 graph or unrelated public product behavior change?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Compiled authenticated local administration routes exercised on desktop and 390px with persisted reload and connected API responses.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated contract, integration and negative-state tests plus a route-by-route browser evidence ledger for all nine affected families.

effectiveness.baseline: The supplied plan reports missing Professor answers/shortcuts, uncertain spa booking visibility, opaque report and quality states, ambiguous content/magazine statuses and incomplete admin navigation.
effectiveness.target: One cumulative local candidate with zero false-success states, complete actionable navigation and no repeated correction before handoff.
